{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load data to be safe
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
data_dedup = data.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 2: Filter to treatment arm AND exclude rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
# This follows the population definition exactly: treatment arm, deduplicated, exclude -999 in baseline
population_filtered = data_dedup[(data_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment') & (data_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] != -999)]

# Step 3: Compute the fraction responded
responded_count = population_filtered['responded'].sum()
total_in_population = len(population_filtered)

# Final fraction
fraction_responded = responded_count / total_in_population

print(f"Number of treatment arm patients after deduplication and excluding -999 baseline: {total_in_population}")
print(f"Number who responded: {responded_count}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
